# nobus_standalone_network (Resource)

A standalone Nobus network created without an automatic subnet or router.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `admin_state_up` (Boolean)
- `availability_zone` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `mtu` (Number)
- `port_security_enabled` (Boolean)
- `project_id` (String)
- `router_external` (Boolean)
- `shared` (Boolean)
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags for the network. The Nobus API rejects tags when creating a standalone network, so the values are retained in state but are not persisted on the server.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
- `subnet_ids` (List of String)
